extension.description: A dark, cinematic Kodi skin with glass panels and large backdrops. Works with every video add-on: any add-on folder can be a row on Home, with trailers on posters, a full info page, a calendar, sport and live TV.

Een donkere, cinematische Kodi-skin met glazen panelen en grote achtergronden. Werkt met elke video-add-on: elke map van een add-on kan een rij op Home worden, met trailers op posters, een volledige infopagina, een kalender, sport en live tv.
extension.news: 2.1.26: Player info: the Video tab is as big as Overview, with a new row (source and screen); no more 'unknown', HDR shows 10-bit. Seren rows stay when you install Lucent Video while Seren is installed. New and continue picks the next episode in season and episode order. 2.1.25: Episodes · New and continue also shows the next episode after one you watched to the end (series you watched in the last 30 days, when the next episode is out). 2.1.24: Sliders work again: setting the audio offset (and other sliders) no longer shows a big white dot, and left/right changes the value. 2.1.23: Trakt login with Lucent's own Trakt app: no API app to make, no keys to type (a code for trakt.tv/activate). An app of your own keeps working, also without a Client Secret. 2.1.22: Episodes · New and continue: when you are behind on a series with a new episode, the tile is the episode after the last one you saw, not the newest. 2.1.21: Own resume screen on Home for half-watched films and episodes (Continue watching / Start over, with picture, time left and plot): your Kodi library, your own files and add-on rows that remember where you were; Lucent Video titles get Lucent Video's own screen, also from the library (update 49 or newer). 2.1.20: The Favourites tab no longer shows your favourites as a row by itself (as before 2.1.19); add the Favourites widget in Menu and widgets if you want it. Less memory: Trailer on focus runs inside Lucent's helper instead of as a separate script, Home no longer starts a trailer script every time, and the info page starts one script instead of two. A trailer still plays once per title; only after a Lucent update can one you saw play once more, like after a Kodi restart. 2.1.19: Favourites in the side menu show your favourites as a row on Home; without favourites Home and the Favourites screen say You have no favourites yet, with how to add one. Home no longer gets stuck when it loses its selection on a tab without rows: the selection goes to the side menu. 2.1.18: Episodes · New and continue: one tile per series you watch, only the newest new episode, and an episode you are halfway wins over a new one of the same series. Screensaver: no more stuck Home after it (Lucent Screensaver 1.1.5); a short log of Home after the screensaver. 2.1.17: New row from your Kodi library: Episodes · New and continue - the new episodes first, then where you stopped. Works with every add-on that fills the library (Menu and widgets › Kodi library). 2.1.16: Episodes from your Kodi library count with TMDB too: Newest episode · 2 still to come, and the RUNNING / ENDED label. The poster label counts the episode you are on (Lucent Video update 32 or newer). 2.1.15: Season finale only with a real mark (also when TMDB does not answer). Episodes to watch count the episode you are on. Lucent Video rows on Home refresh by themselves after watching. The on-screen keyboard opens on OK. Maker: Wilfried van der Voort. A log of the first seconds back on Home. 2.1.14: The newest episode of a season that is still running is no longer called the season finale: Lucent only does that when TMDB marks the episode as the finale; otherwise it says Newest episode. 2.1.13: The Up Next add-on's pop-ups (Up next and Still there?) in Lucent's own look: a dark card at the bottom right. When two series share a name (such as Millennium), Lucent picks the one whose episode aired on that date, so the episodes left are right. Streaming service tiles show one logo on a dark card. 2.1.12: Episodes left and the series' scores on Home also work for add-ons that give an episode without the series' TMDB number (such as TMDb Movies): Lucent finds the series by its name. 2.1.11: Episodes left next to the episode title no longer counts episodes that are not out yet (Newest episode · 2 still to come). 2.1.10: What's new lists the skin and Lucent Video in the exact order they were published. 2.1.9: With Lucent Video, the Tonight for you row shows Lucent Video's own For you list with its full menu; without it (or when that list is empty) the skin picks titles itself. 2.1.8: What's new also lists the updates of Lucent Video. The update window shows notes in your language and offers a restart when an update brings new texts. New pop-up for new episodes with the poster (Watch now / Open series / Later), one pop-up for a whole season out at once. Rows on Home no longer reload at every trailer, and show grey cards while they load. Episodes left sits next to the episode title. The setup assistant shows both Trakt and Simkl when you use both. 2.1.7: With the sound muted the volume bar no longer stays on screen: it shows Muted for a moment and then fades away. 2.1.6: The Finale label on Home now also shows for episodes from TMDb Helper and add-ons built on it (season, series and mid-season finales), not only for your own video add-on. 2.1.5: The intro also shows on slower boxes such as CoreELEC (before only the sound): the picture now starts together with the sound once Kodi is done starting. Calendar Month in a new look: the month on the left with a picture on each day, the chosen day on the right like in List. The calendar fetches everything again once, so midseason finale and finale labels show for episodes you already had; titles and summaries without a translation show in English instead of 'Episode 6'. 2.1.4: The intro shows again (only a glow or black before). Calendar in a new look: List with the series picture well in view and the day as a heading, Week with one day per page and big cards (up / down: previous / next day), and red labels for midseason finale, season finale and premieres. Back in the calendar first goes up to Week / List / Month. The Continue watching row from your library is no longer added to the Films and Series tabs by itself; add it yourself as a widget when you want it (Menu and widgets > Kodi library: Movies in progress, Shows in progress or the new Episodes in progress). The settings level button in Kodi's settings and add-on settings works again (Basic, Standard, Advanced, Expert). 2.1.3: New intro at start (about 6 seconds, sharp on 4K, with a warm sound that has its own switch in Skin settings) and the new logo everywhere in the skin. Continue watching from your library holds the real films and episodes, with Kodi's full menu. Rows no longer jump when a trailer loads or a menu opens over Home. Media flags in the lists as white logos (4K, Dolby Vision, HDR10, Atmos, TrueHD, DTS, 7.1 …), plus the source (Blu-ray, web, HDTV, DVD) for library files. OMDb / MDBList scores on Home too. On an episode on Home: episodes left in the season, and a season premiere / finale label. The update message also recognises in-between updates of your video add-on (beta 1, update 6). Skin settings: Right on Setup assistant, Backup and Kids mode lands on the OK button, so you see where you are. The Continue watching row from your library can be switched off (Skin settings, on by default). 2.1.2: Trailers on Home no longer start and stop over and over (the loading circle and the jump to the row below are gone). A–Z sorting now works for every Home row, also add-on folders that only give names and genre rows. The Streaming services row is tidy again: every logo on a calm dark card, without a second stretched logo or coloured blocks behind it. Trakt through your video add-on works with its new Trakt link (link it again once when the add-on asks). 2.1.1: Titles Lucent opens itself (Tonight for you, actors, collections, calendar) play with the video add-on you have, also TMDb Helper with your players; similar titles work with TMDb Helper too. Tonight for you is on the Home tab only, and only when an add-on can play its titles. The Continue watching row from the library shows films on the Films tab, series on the Series tab, and is gone from Home and the other tabs. The settings level button says what it does. 2.1.0 - RC 2: Release candidate 2. Big maintenance: the whole skin was checked for bugs and unused parts. Lucent works with every video add-on and with Lucent Video. Lucent's update message now also shows new versions of Lucent Video. On/off choices in Settings have a switch and rows that open another screen have an arrow everywhere. 2.0.4: The Continue watching row from your Kodi library is always on Home and holds series only. Lists remember the title you were on. IMDb is back on the first row when the other scores are off. Faster on new installations and lighter in the background; the animated streaming logos are gone. Ready for version 1.0 of your video add-on. 2.0.3: One Continue watching row from your Kodi library (Skin settings). Continue watching and next up in one row from your video add-on (Menu and widgets). With touch or a mouse the side menu only opens on its icons. Light mode in the setup assistant no longer hangs Kodi. No calendar notification button for films in your library. 2.0.1: Own Trakt login (Skin settings > Follow > Trakt login), works with every video add-on. Mark intro button in the player menu. 2.0.0 - RC 1: Release candidate 1. Big check-up: Lucent now works with your video add-on and your own add-on folders only; the code for one older video add-on is gone. Similar titles on the info page come from your video add-on. The skin no longer installs Lucent Subtitles by itself (your video add-on does subtitles); it stays in the Lucent repository for who only wants a subtitle add-on. The YouTube trailer fix moved to Help and info. Unused texts and code removed. 1.43.0: Season page: choose how the episodes are shown (side menu > Episodes as): Row, Timeline, Episode cards or List with flags. What's new: OK on a change opens it on its own with a picture, the whole explanation, how to use it in steps and a Try it now button. 1.42.0: Seven new views for series and episodes (List side menu > View). Series: Banner list (logo, how many episodes you saw, status), Progress rings (posters with a ring) and Mosaic (the chosen series big, the others as tiles). Episodes: Timeline (big stills on a line with dots for what you saw), Episode cards (two columns), Up next stack (with the reason, like where you stopped) and List with flags (4K, HDR, sound, subtitles). Music: Vinyl (a record turns slowly next to the sleeve, not in light mode), Artist wall, Album with track list, Coverflow and Discography timeline. Film series: Collection shelf. Everything: Recently added. The side menu now opens from every new view (Left on the first item) and Right goes back. 1.41.1: Clean-up: for films and series Lucent offers your video add-on and the folders of your own add-ons; the extra settings, buttons, setup step and texts for one other video add-on are gone. The hint on the season page now simply says OK: play. 1.41.0: Four new views for films and series: Spotlight, Wall with info panel, Carousel and Title card (List side menu > View). A trailer on Home now plays only once per title until Kodi starts again. The calendar bell is back on the season page for series from other add-ons that still get new episodes. New button in the player menu: What did they say? (10 seconds back with the subtitles on for a moment), with a video add-on that offers it. Add-on settings: the group headings are bigger, with more room above them. 1.40.3: New setting Watching > Close the player menu by itself: while a video plays, the player menu goes away after 3 to 15 seconds without a button press. While a video plays the skin does no background work beyond what is needed, so the box has everything for the picture. On CoreELEC the setup assistant warns when 'Adjust display refresh rate' is off (Dolby Vision needs it), and its button only switches it on. 1.40.2: Series page: the status of the series (Ended, Continuing, Cancelled, In production) is now also shown for series from add-ons and your Kodi library, and the text above the episodes tells what the chosen episode is about. 1.40.1: Scores with logos (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes fresh or rotten, RT audience, Metacritic, Letterboxd) in the lists and on the info page, via Skin settings > Rating logos > Fetch. 1.40.0: The settings screen of add-ons is new, in three columns: groups, settings and a card that explains the focused setting (for the video add-on of the Lucent repository with a tile and picture per group). New icons of Lucent parts show as soon as Kodi starts again.
